title: Repair PR #298 CI: missing OIDC deps, gofmt, grpc CVE
goal: Unblock PR #298 (release v0.12.0): modules/auth/oidc imports github.com/coreos/go-oidc/v3/oidc and golang.org/x/oauth2 but go.mod/go.sum lacked them, failing vet/unit/backend tests; oidc/handler.go had a gofmt violation failing Go Lint; google.golang.org/grpc v1.61.2 carries Dependabot alert #28 (high, xDS DoS) failing the Dependency Vulnerabilities gate. Port dependency fixes onto release/v0.11.2, format the handler, and bump grpc to v1.76.0.

out: any change to OIDC provider/handler logic beyond formatting
release tag/merge decisions for PR #298 (human gate)
